These are native render events, not attack/damage events; external listener behavior is not invented.

Existing server protocol retained separately. This is table acquisition/tutorial control, not combat input or owner state. Drawing/readers, JEI category/recipe layouts and ordinary screens preserve original ingredient/display/native menu state.

Actual existing ClientProxy/ClientEvents consumers are presentation. No damage, explosion, effect callback, controller admission or source request is added by these cache writes; real nuclear payload remains separately canonical.

Exact remaining native bodies use model-box/mesh/pose/vertex and shader APIs, particle-local age/position/colors, render buffers/textures, sound playback, or client render/UI mixins. Iterable model-part callbacks mutate original model geometry; client entity/status/world reads retain canonical gameplay consumers separately. Native rendering resources, registry layout, view cancellation and exception/lifecycle behavior remain native; package names are routing only.
